feed.title: Natalia M. Sikora
feed.subtitle: Dr Natalia Sikora is an AI researcher, a startup co-founder and CEO, and an ex-EPSRC Postdoctoral Fellow and machine learning researcher specialising in multimodal data fusion, explainable AI (XAI), and biomedical AI. Swansea, Oxford, Nottingham. She received her PhD from Swansea University, and spent 2 years as student researcher in LICR, University of Oxford.
